I replied to Hollis in a thread on their #central-team message. The only deadline on record is the one Pree posted in that channel on 14 October: 25 August, with no year given. Pree hasn't answered my question about whether they meant 2027, so I suggested Hollis check the year with Pree before updating the account sheet.

The signing date is an operational fact and Hollis is in #central-team, so sharing it there was fine.

My summary from last time was also posted in #central-team as a normal channel message, so the team can see it. It only covers the same deadline and nothing sensitive, but you may want to check why it ended up there.
